oneOf.description: A specific agent instance.

A named tool. The runtime resolves name → plugin via its
registration table.
A human user (e.g. the operator at the CLI).
The runtime / observer.
Manifest seen, package not yet installed.
Package installed on disk, ready to instantiate.
Instance created, idle.
Actively processing a message.
Intentionally halted.

The agent failed. `kind` enables typed retry/restart logic;
`detail` carries human-readable specifics.

kind.description: Typed failure category for restart logic.

oneOf.description: Agent process crashed unexpectedly (panic, signal, abort).
Configured LLM backend returned an error or was unreachable.
A capability check denied an operation the agent attempted.
Agent exceeded a resource limit (memory, message rate, timeout).

Catch-all for failures that don't match the named kinds.
See: [escape-hatches.md#failurekind-internalerror](../docs/explanation/escape-hatches.md#failurekind-internalerror).

created_at.description:
When the message was created (UTC). Supplied by the caller's
`Clock` port in the no_std kernel; the std `Message::new`
convenience stamps `Utc::now()`.

`chrono::DateTime<Utc>` is foreign to this crate, so it cannot
carry its own `#[cfg_attr(schema, derive(JsonSchema))]` (orphan
rule). Its serde representation is an RFC3339 string (chrono's
default `Serialize`), so `schemars(with = "String")` describes
the actual wire shape without touching serde.

headers.description: Free-form headers. `BTreeMap` for stable iteration order.

parent_id.description: Optional pointer to the message this one replies to.

oneOf.description:
Human- or agent-authored text. The envelope's `sender` field
distinguishes origin.

A tool invocation. The envelope's `recipient: Address::Tool(...)`
names the tool; this carries the arguments.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the tool.

oneOf.description: Successful tool result.
Tool returned an error.
Lifecycle event broadcast (System → observers).

Plugin-specific message kind.
See: [escape-hatches.md#messagepayload-custom](../docs/explanation/escape-hatches.md#messagepayload-custom).
Agent completed and produced a final response.

all_messages.description:
Full conversation history: initial message + every LLM
response + every tool_use / tool_result.

final_message.description: The final assistant message (LLM response with no tool_uses).

token_usage.description: Token usage summed across the run.

total_turns.description: Number of agent loop iterations performed.

oneOf.description:
Agent ran but failed via a typed `FailureKind`. Partial
conversation preserved.

all_messages.description: Full conversation history up to the failure point.

status.description:
Always `AgentStatus::Failed { kind, detail }`. The `kind`
distinguishes `PolicyDenied` (capability denial),
`OutOfResources` (max turns reached), `BackendError`,
`Crashed`, `InternalError`.

token_usage.description: Token usage summed across the run.

total_turns.description: Number of agent loop iterations performed.

StopReason.description:
Reason a completion stopped.

`StopReason::Error` indicates the stream completed but reported an
error mid-flight; this is distinct from [`crate::LlmError`], which
indicates the trait method itself failed.

oneOf.description: Model finished naturally.
Hit the `max_tokens` cap.
Matched one of the configured stop sequences.
Model emitted a tool-use block and is awaiting its result.

Stream completed but reported an error mid-flight (distinct
from [`crate::LlmError`], which is a trait-method failure).

input_tokens.description: Tokens consumed from the input (system + messages + tools).
Total input (prompt) tokens used across the run.

output_tokens.description: Total output (completion) tokens emitted across the run.

total_tokens.description: `Some(n)` when the backend reports a unified count; `None` otherwise.

oneOf.description: Plain-text content.
Structured JSON content, carried as a `tau_domain::Value`.

content.description: Multi-block content describing the tool's output.

is_error.description:
Whether the tool ran but reports a semantic error to the LLM.
Distinct from [`crate::ToolError`], which signals a trait-method
failure.

oneOf.description:
Run started. Emitted once, before the first turn. Typed
counterpart of the `runtime.run_started` tracing event (β.7.5:
promoted to a typed variant so a no_std wasm guest can produce the
β.6 conformance observable over a single channel — see ADR-0049).

A β.4 context-pipeline transform ran. Emitted once per transform
per turn, carrying the step name and the pre/post token estimates.
Typed counterpart of the `runtime.context_step_ran` tracing event.

tokens_in.description: Token estimate of the view entering this transform.

tokens_out.description: Token estimate of the view leaving this transform.

oneOf.description:
The per-turn LLM request was built and is about to be sent. Typed
counterpart of the `llm.request_built` tracing event.

The per-turn LLM response finished streaming. Typed counterpart of
`llm.response_received` folded with `llm.token_usage`: carries the
turn's `StopReason` and token usage (zero when the provider did not
report usage).

tokens_in.description: Input tokens reported for this turn (`0` if unreported).

tokens_out.description: Output tokens reported for this turn (`0` if unreported).

oneOf.description:
LLM emitted a text fragment. Concatenate with previous deltas
for the running assistant message text.

LLM emitted a complete `tool_use` block. Fires immediately
when the kernel sees `CompletionChunk::ToolUse` — BEFORE the
tool is dispatched. Display intent: "agent wants to call X
with args Y". The matching `ToolCallCompleted` fires after
dispatch finishes.

Tool dispatch finished. Fires after `Tool::invoke` returns,
regardless of success/failure. Carries the tool result OR a
validation/dispatch error message.

result.description:
`Ok(ToolResult)` on success; `Err(reason)` for validation
failures or other recoverable errors. Plugin-crash-class
errors don't surface here — they terminate the run via
`RunCompleted`.

oneOf.description:
One turn of the agent loop completed. The LLM's `Finish`
chunk arrived AND any tool calls within the turn finished
dispatching.

usage.description:
Token usage for this turn. `None` if the provider did
not report.

oneOf.description:
Terminal event. Always exactly one per stream. After this
fires, the stream returns `None`.

outcome.description: Final outcome — same shape as `Runtime::run` returns.

oneOf.description:
Kernel-level fatal error (ADR-0006 § error dichotomy). In the
batch path (`run_with_history` / `run`), the drainer converts
this to `Err(RuntimeError)`. Streaming callers should treat
this as an unrecoverable run abort.

Distinct from `RunCompleted { Failed { BackendError } }` which
signals an agent-level failure the caller can handle gracefully.

context_json.description:
Optional extra context (e.g. `tool_name`, `registered` list).
Encoded as a JSON string for simplicity across crate boundaries.

kind.description:
`RuntimeError` variant name for structured dispatch.
One of: `"ToolNotRegistered"`, `"Llm"`, `"Tool"`, `"Internal"`.

tool_error_variant.description:
When `kind == "Tool"`, the inner `ToolError` variant name
(`"BadArgs"`, `"Internal"`, `"SessionDead"`, `"DeadlineExceeded"`,
`"CapabilityDenied"`, `"Llm"`, `"Storage"`). `None` for all
other `kind` values. Used by the batch drainer to reconstruct
the typed `ToolError` variant losslessly (Approach A fix).
